match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Mina pulls out the lipstick, applies one final swipe, and turns toward Scarlett. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Scarlett and Mina lean along the low concrete wall on opposite thirds, peach skyline and distant train layered behind them. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett and Mina lean against the rooftop wall at sunset, with the coral lipstick still in Mina’s pocket and wind lifting their hair. Camera, as one or two arrows: orbit, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. Mina, Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s, Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
